title: Force-inline scalar helper functions inside Venus tasks
proposed_rule: A C helper reachable from a Venus task that has ordinary scalar or pointer parameters must be declared VENUS_INLINE so VenusSplit sees only the ABI-valid task entry point. Keep task entry parameters restricted to Venus vectors and aligned structs.
prompt: If VenusSplit reports 'Inputs should only be venus vectors and structs', inspect helper functions before changing the algorithm. Mark pure task-local scalar helpers VENUS_INLINE and re-run the independent compile; do not weaken task ABI checks.
rollback: Revert the workload commit; no compiler, Gem5, scheduler, or RTL source is changed.
